The [[Keeper of Illusion]] is one of the [[Forgotten]] collectors who award [[Forgotten weapon]]s in exchange for a [[Book of Secrets]], the [[Nightfall]] end-game reward item. 

==Location==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**{{NPC location|Throne of Secrets}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Laugh, my friend, for in your actions you have at last seen behind the mask. How many can say they have seen the true face of truth? Bring to me 1 Book of Secrets, and I will celebrate your great victory with another glimpse at that which lies behind the veil."''
